title: PCB write
observations: importChanges(false) returned true and materialised the schematic onto the PCB copy.
Moved an existing PCB component (DC1) by +50/+50 raw units via pcb_PrimitiveComponent.modify; immediate readback found the same designator at the new pose.
pcb_Document.save() returned true; after session close + reopen, the DC1 pose matched the saved pose within 2 raw units.
The PCB layer/net/component read surface used for readback was already measured in W03.
risks: importChanges is a whole-schematic rebuild of the PCB, not a minimal diff
no undo; a wrong move is only recoverable by re-editing
primitiveId is session-scoped: locate by designator after reopen
save true is not persistence: the reopen readback is the evidence
